%.name: remainder
%.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.

- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.

⊲.name: list cons
⊲.plain: a ⊲ b places integer a before the elements of list b.

⌃.name: list head
⌃.plain: a ⌃ is the first integer in a; an empty list gives NaN.

⌄.name: list tail
⌄.plain: a ⌄ removes the first element of a; an empty list stays empty.

ℒ.name: list length
ℒ.plain: a ℒ is the number of integers in list a.

⊞.name: list append
⊞.plain: a ⊞ b joins list a followed by list b.

Σ.name: list sum
Σ.plain: a Σ is the sum of the integers in list a.

⊙.name: list at
⊙.plain: a ⊙ b is element b of a, counting from zero; an invalid index gives NaN.

≍.name: list equal
≍.plain: a ≍ b is true exactly when lists a and b have the same elements in order.
